basis: The firm's own 2008 Energy Technology list (captured July 2008) and its 2013 detail page (CompanyDetail.aspx?id=1347, Current, Private) list Glacier Bay, Inc., 'an energy technology platform company'; its August 2009 Form D names NEA's Mark Perry and Arno Penzias as directors.

note: Energy-efficiency products maker in Union City, California (incorporated 2006), not the recycling-robotics Glacier the firm backed in 2022. The firm listed it by July 2008 (the entry year). A lender's 2011 schedule (BlueCrest Capital Finance N-2/A) holds a warrant on its Series A preferred, the only preferred series on record, so NEA's entry reads as the Series A; the 2009 Form D sold $4.3M of a $10M offering. Nothing names the company after the firm's 2013 page, so its fate is unknown.

basis: X1, one company with the not_member Sunesis row: Sunesis Pharmaceuticals merged with private Viracta in 2021 and took its name, and the firm's own 2024-2026 page names it 'Viracta Therapeutics (formerly Sunesis)'. NEA's position is the April 2009 private placement into already listed Sunesis (8-K of 2009-04-01), with no earlier NEA private round, so the listed company's later name is out on the same test.

note: The Growth band rode the company's first own Form D (a $50M offering, March 2015), but the firm's own entry year is 2013 and Lightspeed's card has the seed in 2011, so NEA entered in a round between the two that no source names: the stage is undetermined.
